replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
Luar is different from other maps. It's not meant for easy rushing. Instead, its easier to PVP on that map. If you want to rush, there are still tactics, like there are for every map. You can sneak along the edge, tunnel, skybridge, etc. But most of the time I just skybridge, unless that doesn't work. Then I would just sneak through their base. IMO gameplay is amazing on that map.

Defenders usually don't have an advantage either. The monument is shaped a lot like Quintus, except without the glass and water. If you defend by removing everything and using pressure plates, a rusher can easily win by skybridging and killing the defender with a spanky spade. If they cover it in wood, that's even better. If they use the box strategy for defending, there's a tactic for that which works on every map.

Luar is one of my favorite maps.
